about: Frame 1's drawn share sheet and the page behind it, in each language: English words on the boards (docs/handover/design/AppStore1 and AppStore-iPad-1) to this language's. The share sheet's own words come from packages/i18n (share, app reader); the page is a made-up recipe.

es.15-minute chilli oil noodles: Fideos con aceite de chile en 15 minutos
es.Boil the noodles. While they cook, pour: Cuece los fideos. Mientras se hacen, vierte aceite caliente sobre ajo, chile en copos y sésamo.
es.Slow-roast tomato orzo, the 30-minute on: Orzo con tomates asados, el de 30 minutos
es.Roast the tomatoes hot and fast, then st: Asa los tomates fuerte y rápido, y echa el orzo directamente en la bandeja. Una sola fuente, y el horno trabaja mientras pones la mesa.
es.Finish with lemon, more olive oil than y: Termina con limón, más aceite de oliva del que crees y las hierbas frescas que haya en la nevera.

pt-BR.15-minute chilli oil noodles: Macarrão com óleo de pimenta em 15 minutos
pt-BR.Boil the noodles. While they cook, pour: Cozinhe o macarrão. Enquanto cozinha, despeje óleo quente sobre alho, pimenta em flocos e gergelim.
pt-BR.Weeknights · 6 min read: Dias de semana · 6 min de leitura
pt-BR.Slow-roast tomato orzo, the 30-minute on: Orzo com tomate assado, o de 30 minutos
pt-BR.Roast the tomatoes hot and fast, then st: Asse os tomates em forno bem quente e misture o orzo direto na assadeira. Uma forma só, e o forno trabalha enquanto você põe a mesa.
pt-BR.Finish with lemon, more olive oil than y: Termine com limão, mais azeite do que você imagina e as ervas frescas que tiver na geladeira.

fr.15-minute chilli oil noodles: Nouilles à l'huile pimentée en 15 minutes
fr.Boil the noodles. While they cook, pour: Faites cuire les nouilles. Pendant ce temps, versez de l'huile chaude sur l'ail, le piment en flocons et le sésame.
fr.Slow-roast tomato orzo, the 30-minute on: Orzo aux tomates rôties, celui en 30 minutes
fr.Roast the tomatoes hot and fast, then st: Rôtissez les tomates à four bien chaud, puis versez l'orzo directement dans le plat. Un seul plat, et le four fait le travail pendant que vous mettez la table.
fr.Finish with lemon, more olive oil than y: Finissez avec du citron, plus d'huile d'olive que vous ne le pensez, et les herbes fraîches qui restent dans le frigo.

de.Boil the noodles. While they cook, pour: Nudeln kochen. Währenddessen heißes Öl über Knoblauch, Chiliflocken und Sesam gießen.
de.Roast the tomatoes hot and fast, then st: Die Tomaten heiß und schnell rösten, dann den Orzo direkt in die Form rühren. Eine Form, und der Ofen arbeitet, während du den Tisch deckst.
de.Finish with lemon, more olive oil than y: Zum Schluss Zitrone, mehr Olivenöl als gedacht und die frischen Kräuter, die noch im Kühlschrank sind.

ja.Boil the noodles. While they cook, pour: 麺をゆでる。その間に、にんにく、唐辛子、ごまに熱した油をかける。
ja.Slow-roast tomato orzo, the 30-minute on: 焼きトマトのオルゾ、30分で
ja.Roast the tomatoes hot and fast, then st: トマトを高温で一気に焼き、オルゾをそのまま天板に混ぜ込む。鍋はひとつ。テーブルを整えるあいだにオーブンが仕上げてくれる。
ja.Finish with lemon, more olive oil than y: 仕上げにレモンと、思うより多めのオリーブオイル、冷蔵庫にあるハーブを。

it.Boil the noodles. While they cook, pour: Cuoci i noodles. Intanto versa olio bollente su aglio, peperoncino in fiocchi e sesamo.
it.Slow-roast tomato orzo, the 30-minute on: Orzo con pomodori arrosto, quello da 30 minuti
it.Roast the tomatoes hot and fast, then st: Arrostisci i pomodori a fuoco alto, poi mescola l'orzo direttamente nella teglia. Una teglia sola, e il forno lavora mentre apparecchi.
it.Finish with lemon, more olive oil than y: Finisci con limone, più olio d'oliva di quanto pensi e le erbe fresche che hai in frigo.

nl.Boil the noodles. While they cook, pour: Kook de noedels. Giet ondertussen hete olie over knoflook, chilivlokken en sesam.
nl.Slow-roast tomato orzo, the 30-minute on: Orzo met geroosterde tomaat, die van 30 minuten
nl.Roast the tomatoes hot and fast, then st: Rooster de tomaten heet en snel en roer de orzo er direct in de schaal door. Eén schaal, en de oven doet het werk terwijl jij de tafel dekt.
nl.Finish with lemon, more olive oil than y: Maak af met citroen, meer olijfolie dan je denkt en de verse kruiden die nog in de koelkast liggen.

ko.Boil the noodles. While they cook, pour: 면을 삶는다. 삶는 동안 마늘, 고춧가루, 깨 위에 뜨거운 기름을 붓는다.
ko.Roast the tomatoes hot and fast, then st: 토마토를 센 불에 빠르게 굽고, 오르조를 바로 팬에 넣어 섞는다. 팬 하나면 끝. 상을 차리는 동안 오븐이 다 해 준다.
ko.Finish with lemon, more olive oil than y: 레몬과 생각보다 넉넉한 올리브유, 냉장고에 있는 허브로 마무리.

zh-Hans.Boil the noodles. While they cook, pour: 把面煮上。煮面的时候，把热油浇在蒜末、辣椒碎和芝麻上。
zh-Hans.Weeknights · 6 min read: 工作日 · 阅读 6 分钟
zh-Hans.Slow-roast tomato orzo, the 30-minute on: 烤番茄意式米粒面，30 分钟版
zh-Hans.Roast the tomatoes hot and fast, then st: 番茄高温快烤，再把米粒面直接拌进烤盘。一个盘子搞定，你摆桌子的工夫，烤箱就做好了。
zh-Hans.Finish with lemon, more olive oil than y: 最后挤点柠檬，橄榄油比你想的多放一些，再加上冰箱里有的香草。
